note: Ingest windows, fiducial settings and SQI flags for device recordings (docs/data_convention.md section 4, docs/protocol/device_session_pipeline.md). Proposed 2026-11-13; revised after discussion and approved 2026-11-14 (docs/protocol/device_session_pipeline.md sections 4.3 and 5); window and fiducial settings stay pilot settings, locked on the pilot. SQI thresholds are copies of the proposals in docs/protocol/sqi_specification_v1.md and stay unlocked until G2; nothing here was chosen on BP; the ECG lead-off level (sqi_hardware, 2026-11-24) was set on an electrode-removal test of a team member, all other values on no device recording.

sources.window: Protocol v0.3 section 6.2: 60 s stored before t0; sensitivity windows 10/20/30/60 s; primary 30 s is the proposal of sqi_specification_v1.md section 2, to be locked on the pilot.
sources.pat_ppg_color: Slot 1 (green on V1) is the time origin of the PPG slots (Packet Schema V0.1 section 7), so its PAT does not depend on the LED_PW spacing. The colour serves every feature of the table (PPG morphology, PPG HR and PAT), not PAT only; chosen in advance so no channel is picked on results. Approved 2026-11-14 as the pilot setting. Features are computed for every colour.
sources.signal: Defaults of features-sqi-v1/v2 (software/signal_processing/fiducials.py SignalConfig); every value is in seconds, so nothing depends on 125 Hz. The rate comes from the data (ECG 512, PPG 200 sps). Filtering changed 2026-11-15 from none to zero_phase with the default bands (ECG 0.5-40 Hz, PPG 0.5-8 Hz, Butterworth order 2 applied forward and backward inside each window): the MAX30001 digital high-pass is off because the 0.5 Hz high-pass was planned offline (configs/hardware/custom_board_proposal.md, 2026-10-25), and without it baseline wander hides beats (SYNTHETIC test, tests/test_device_features.py). Pilot setting, locked on the pilot by fiducial accuracy, never by RQ1 errors; edge behaviour and the bias of the filtered tangent foot are open (docs/protocol/device_session_pipeline.md section 3.4).
sources.pat_validity: Same values as configs/data/week05_fiducials.json (pat-validity-v1). mad_floor_ms 10 ms stays above the PPG sample period at 200 sps (5 ms).
sources.sqi_hardware: sqi_specification_v1.md section 3.3: ADC saturation > 5 % of the window (protocol 6.1 and 7.3); the other hardware flags fire on any packet. Not locked (G2). ECG lead-off (decided 2026-11-24, device-features-v3, bring-up report 9.10 and sync_10min_test_plan.md 11.4): STATUS bit 2 is not used (on the breakout v2 it is set with good contact too); the window is flagged and gets no PAT when an ECG sample of [window start - 30 s, t0) reaches |35 mV|, 70 % of the 50 mV full scale (VREF 1 V, gain 20 V/V, checked against CNFG_ECG when the chip state is in the recording). Set from the electrode-removal test (about 41 mV with a lead off; ECG and motion under 10 mV), not from BP.
